description: Proposer-is-not-executor attestation for an irreversible action. Records a proposal duty and an execution duty over one target record; the library enforces distinct actors (IAA-1), distinct signer keys (IAA-2) and execution not before proposal (IAA-3). Crypto-bearing: signatures, when present, are verified by the consumer (IAA-5).

contract_version.description: Hounfour contract version. Pinned to "8.8.0", the line that introduced this envelope.

attestation_id.description: Stable opaque identifier for this attestation (UUID).

action_kind.description: Kind of irreversible action being attested. Which kinds are irreversible in a given system is consumer policy (IAA-N2).

target.description: The record the irreversible action applies to.

schema_id.description: PascalCase $id of the schema of the record the action applies to (for example "MergeArtifact" or "ForgetRecord"). IAA-4.

record_id.description: Identifier of the target record in the consumer system. Existence is not checked (IAA-N1).

content_hash.description: Optional sha256 of the target record content at proposal time. Pattern only; the library does not recompute it (IAA-N1).

proposal.description: The proposing duty: who asked for the action.

actor_id.description: Consumer-shaped actor identifier. Compared by exact string equality (IAA-1); the library does not normalise identifiers (IAA-N3). The 256-character bound matches MergeArtifact.merger_actor_id so a merge actor can be carried unchanged.

signer_key_id.description: Signer key identifier, 64 lowercase hex characters (the bare sha256-derived form used by PhaseCompletionEnvelope). Compared by exact string equality (IAA-2).

proposed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant at which the action was proposed.

signature.description: Optional ed25519 signature (unpadded base64url, 86 characters after the "ed25519:" prefix) over the signing input described in the schema JSDoc (IAA-5). Not verified by the library.

execution.description: The executing duty: who carried the action out.

actor_id.description: Consumer-shaped actor identifier. Compared by exact string equality (IAA-1); the library does not normalise identifiers (IAA-N3). The 256-character bound matches MergeArtifact.merger_actor_id so a merge actor can be carried unchanged.

signer_key_id.description: Signer key identifier, 64 lowercase hex characters (the bare sha256-derived form used by PhaseCompletionEnvelope). Compared by exact string equality (IAA-2).

executed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC instant at which the action was executed. MUST NOT be before proposal.proposed_at (IAA-3).

signature.description: Optional ed25519 signature (unpadded base64url, 86 characters after the "ed25519:" prefix) over the signing input described in the schema JSDoc (IAA-5). Not verified by the library.

policy.description: The separation-of-duties policy this envelope attests.

waiver_reference.description: Informational pointer to a consumer-side waiver. Does NOT relax IAA-1 / IAA-2 inside validate(); a consumer that honours waivers does so outside validate() (IAA-N5).
